description: Create, revise, export or permanently delete a contact (confirm: true required; owner cannot be deleted). Export without contact exports the whole database. Lifecycle lost is soft delete. ALWAYS search_affinity first before creating — duplicates corrupt the graph.

contact.description: Target contact. Required when action=revise or set_lifecycle. Provide contactId or identity.

input.description: New contact payload. Required when action=create.

bootstrapOwner.description: Whether this contact should be the owner.

doNotContact.description: Block outbound engagement unless explicitly overridden.

identities.description: Optional identities to attach. An identity owned by another live contact causes a conflict, or returns that contact when ifExists=return.

now.description: Optional timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

ifExists.description: Identity collision policy; return attaches nothing.

now.description: Optional timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

kind.description: Replacement contact kind for migrate_kind. Owner must remain human or agent. Audited without bond mechanics.

lifecycleState.description: Target lifecycle state. Required when action=set_lifecycle.

now.description: Optional timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

patch.description: Allowed contact patch. Required when action=revise.

doNotContact.description: Block outbound engagement unless explicitly overridden.

tz.description: IANA time zone for due days and local calendar calculations; defaults to TZ or the process local zone.
